Provenance.description:
Provenance record attached to every data file (docs/DATA_POLICY.md §3).

All fourteen keys are always present. A record either cites a dataset completely (dataset, version,
provider, url and accessed all filled) or has `dataset: null` and says in `notes` what the content is
instead (synthetic demo content, user input, a domain table). No field may hold UNVERIFIED or an
unfilled <placeholder>.

SensitivityResult.description:
Weight sensitivity check (T-024b, D-024, FIX2 §4.2), the replacement for an expert AHP matrix.

Each factor's weight is moved by +delta and by -delta in turn. `stable` is the strict test (same units at
Severe on the same days in every variant); the flood-day lists say which units are Severe on the flood days.

delta.description: Size of the weight change applied to each factor, with both signs.

flood_days.description: The flood days: the documented flood's dates widened by the verification window (config/alerts.yaml verification.days_before and verification.days_after).

stable.description: True exactly when every variant has same_days.

SensitivityVariant.description:
One variant of the weight sensitivity check (T-024b): one factor's weight moved by `delta`, the other four
rescaled so the five still sum to 1, and the replay re-run (pipeline/engine/sensitivity.py). It is compared with
the baseline run (the design weights) on which units reach Severe and on which days.

delta.description: Signed change of that factor's weight, before clipping to 0..1.

weights.description: The five weights of this variant after rescaling (optional).

same_units.description: The same units reach Severe as in the baseline.

same_days.description: Same units, and each is Severe on exactly the same days (the strict test).

units_gained.description: Units at Severe in this variant only.
